defects.reproduction: NONE (idiom conformance, not behaviour).
defects.proposedCure: Moot if L-6/L-7's cure removes the ref entirely. Recorded because the pattern is repo-wide; where a template ref genuinely survives, use useTemplateRef.

defects.defect: The same concept has two homes on opposite sides of the library boundary: palette EXTRACTION is library-owned and published, palette GENERATION is demo-owned — although the generation core is pure, seeded, Vue-free library-grade code.
defects.evidence: extract: src/quantize.ts → published as @mkbabb/value.js/quantize (quantizePixels, dominantColor), consumed at demo/workbenches/extract/quantize-worker.ts:6. generate: demo/color-session/generate-color.ts, 243 lines, whose only imports are @mkbabb/value.js/color, @mkbabb/value.js/css and a local mulberry32 from demo/color-session/prng.ts. src/ contains no mulberry32/prng (grep -rn 'mulberry|prng' src/ → no matches) although @mkbabb/value.js/math is described at src/subpaths/math.ts:1-6 as "pure numeric math … parse-that-FREE" and already carries clamp/scale/lerp/deCasteljau. Corroborating cost of the no-root-export posture: demo/shared/utils.ts:9-19 records that `debounce` was stranded with "no rightful subpath home" and got copied into the demo.
defects.mechanism: Family E — generate-color.ts's header (:1-22) explains its home as a cycle break: demo/color-session/useColorParsing.ts:3,120 needs generateSingleColor, and while the math lived in the feature that was a shared→feature edge. True, and the move fixed it — but it fixed a demo-internal cycle by relocating library-grade code SIDEWAYS within the demo rather than DOWN into the library, where the cycle cannot exist at all.
defects.reproduction: NONE — HYPOTHESIS. I did not build a variant to prove the move is clean; the import graph shows no obstacle (generate-color.ts has zero Vue and zero demo imports beyond ./prng), but that is inspection, not measurement.
defects.proposedCure: Move generatePalette / generateSingleColor / GENERATION_PRESETS / HARMONY_DEFS into src/color/ and publish through @mkbabb/value.js/color; move mulberry32 into src/foundation/math and publish through @mkbabb/value.js/math. useColorParsing then imports from the library rather than a demo sibling, and the cycle it was working around cannot recur by construction. Note package.json has NO `.` root export by deliberate design (vite.config.ts:181-183) — this proposal needs none, since ./color is exactly the right key.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownership, dependency direction, public surface) for demo/workbenches/extract/ImageDropZone.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 — exact model id claude-opus-5[1m] (1M-context variant), declared explicitly at spawn; the seat is declared, not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: L-3 + L-4 together — the file-intake capability is homeless. It is split across a leaf presentational component (defineExpose({openFilePicker}) at ImageDropZone.vue:85), its grandparent (ExtractWorkbench.vue:222 ref<InstanceType<typeof ImageDropZone>>, :230-232), a sibling (ExtractControls @upload), and a composable that owns everything about the file EXCEPT how it arrives (useExtractSession.ts:29-36,164-168) — while @vueuse/core@14.3.0 (a direct dependency with 6 existing demo consumers) ships both halves (useDropZone d.ts:1932, useFileDialog d.ts:2626) with correctness properties the hand-roll lacks (single-point dataTypes enforcement; counter-based drag state). This defect GENERATES the others: disableClick (L-5) exists to tell the leaf when its smuggled click means something else, and the undeclared fallthrough @click (L-8) exists because the leaf has no vocabulary for the intent it is actually signalling. Fix the ownership and three findings dissolve with it.
result.negativeProof: Verdict is DEFECTIVE, but eight checks came back SOUND and are recorded in the report so the seat is not hit-only: (1) ImageDropZone imports ONLY `vue` and `@lucide/vue` — zero deep imports, zero @src/*, zero src/ relative reach; a real external consumer could write its import block verbatim. (2) All 29 @mkbabb/value.js specifiers under demo/workbenches name a real exports key; `grep -rn '"@mkbabb/value.js"' demo/` returns no output — no bare-root import survives. (3) verbatimModuleSyntax satisfied — both imports are value imports, no type-only import exists to mis-declare. (4) No second file-intake implementation in the demo: `grep -rn 'type="file"|dataTransfer|@drop|dragover' demo/` returns 4 hits, all in ImageDropZone.vue; FileReader/readAsDataURL only at useExtractSession.ts:31,34. L-4 is under-implementation against an available library, not demo-internal duplication. (5) Not a god module — 113 lines, 3 functions, 1 concept. (6) Its physical home is CORRECT and must NOT be hoisted: one consumer (ExtractWorkbench.vue:15,193,222); promoting to demo/shared/ui/ would violate edict 3 and DESIGN.md:388. (7) @lucide/vue barrel import is the house idiom (47/47 sites) and the package ships no exports map at all (Object.keys(exports) === [], v1.17.0) — no subpath alternative exists. (8) Renders and behaves correctly: REPORT.json /#/extract across all four Safari matrices shows pageErrors [], consoleErrors [], overflowX 0, imgNoAlt 0; the drop zone is not among the 3 namelessButtons; e2e/smoke/walk.spec.ts:78-81 asserts its role=button + Upload-image name green; I read shots/safari-desktop-light/extract.png and shots/safari-mobile-dark/extract.png and the dashed plate, ImagePlus glyph and mono prompt render correctly in both schemes at both sizes. Every finding below is about WHERE things are kept, not what the component does.

defects.defect: `.plate-ink` is a 5-consumer cross-feature recipe living as 5 byte-identical `<style scoped>` twins with no home in demo/styles/, violating the project's own written global-utility law twice over.
defects.evidence: demo/workbenches/extract/ImageDropZone.vue:109-111 (consumed :46, :58). Identical rule `color: var(--ink-muted, var(--muted-foreground));` also at demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue:84, demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue:102, demo/workbenches/extract/ExtractControls.vue:148, demo/workbenches/extract/ExtractWorkbench.vue:290 — pasted side by side in the report. `grep -rn "plate-ink" demo/styles/*.css` → NO OUTPUT. Convicting law: demo/DESIGN.md:388 ("No new global utility class for ONE consumer … The shared survivors are true cross-feature recipes") and demo/styles/utils.css `.swatch-row` block ("A shared recipe (3 consumers) per DESIGN.md's global-utility rule") + `.palettes-ramp-text` block ("never a scoped twin (the S.W7-7 lesson)"). Five consumers span three feature areas: demo/color-picker/, demo/shared/ui/, demo/workbenches/extract/.
defects.mechanism: A concept (the certified de-emphasis ink rung) with no unique home; Vue's <style scoped> gives each copy an isolated namespace, which makes the duplication invisible to every gate. Same species as .gold-shimmer-icon, which utils.css already records having lifted for exactly this reason.
defects.reproduction: $ for f in demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue demo/workbenches/extract/ExtractControls.vue demo/workbenches/extract/ExtractWorkbench.vue demo/workbenches/extract/ImageDropZone.vue; do grep -A2 '^\.plate-ink' "$f"; done   → 5 identical rules; $ grep -rn 'plate-ink' demo/styles/*.css → no output
defects.proposedCure: One rule in demo/styles/utils.css carrying the single justifying comment (the five existing comments collapse into one); delete all five scoped blocks. For ImageDropZone.vue the ENTIRE <style> element disappears — the file becomes a style-free SFC, 113 → ~101 lines.

defects.defect: The `var(--ink-muted, var(--muted-foreground))` fallback is a masking fallback (owner edict 2), and the masked-in value is measurably different from the real one AND is the exact value the component's own comment says FAILED the contrast floor.
defects.evidence: ImageDropZone.vue:110. Measured live via playwright on http://localhost:9000/#/extract: `--ink-muted` = "oklch(44.712054906087% 0.003861589952 34.629978305623deg)" vs `--muted-foreground` = "light-dark(hsl(30 22% 40%), hsl(34 14% 62%))" — two different colours. The component's own comment at ImageDropZone.vue:104-108 states the fallback target is "the STATIC text-muted-foreground THAT FAILED THE TEXT FLOOR over the live-ambient plate in light". Writer of the real token: demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphereBoot.ts:103 (document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--ink-muted", css)).
defects.mechanism: A cross-boundary token seam (boot writes → 8 demo files read) with no declared contract, closed with a var() second argument instead of a guaranteed initial value. This is also the component→boot dependency edge: a leaf in demo/workbenches/ has a hard runtime dependency on demo/color-picker/composables/boot/ carried entirely by an untyped global custom-property name, with no import.
defects.reproduction: $ node scratchpad/probe-utils.mjs → {"inkMuted":"oklch(44.712054906087% 0.003861589952 34.629978305623deg)","mutedForeground":"light-dark(hsl(30 22% 40%), hsl(34 14% 62%))"}. The divergence is measured fact. That a user ever SEES the fallback requires useAtmosphereBoot to not have run or to have thrown — that half is HYPOTHESIS, not reproduced; I did not exercise a boot-failure path.
defects.proposedCure: Declare the seam once: `@property --ink-muted { syntax:"<color>"; inherits:true; initial-value:<certified> }` or a plain `:root { --ink-muted: … }` seed in demo/styles/foundation.css, sited next to the L-1 consolidated rule. Then `.plate-ink { color: var(--ink-muted); }` — one argument, no masking, and the pre-boot value is a declared certified constant rather than a silent substitution of a rejected token.

defects.defect: Inverted ownership: the file-dialog capability lives in the leaf presentational component and the grandparent reaches imperatively INTO it, while the composable that owns the rest of the intake pipeline is missing exactly this one piece.
defects.evidence: ImageDropZone.vue:78 (useTemplateRef fileInputRef), :81-83 (openFilePicker), :85 (defineExpose). ExtractWorkbench.vue:222 (const dropZoneRef = ref<InstanceType<typeof ImageDropZone> | null>(null)), :230-232 (openFilePicker → dropZoneRef.value?.openFilePicker()), :74 (@upload="openFilePicker" from ExtractControls). The rightful owner already exists: useExtractSession.ts:29-36 (readAsDataUrl) and :164-168 (onFile → lastFile, previewDataUrl, runQuantize) — it holds every piece of the intake EXCEPT how the file arrives.
defects.mechanism: Capability placed at the wrong altitude, forcing an expose/InstanceType back channel across two hops to reunite it with its state. ExtractControls (a sibling in the other grid column) emits upward so the workbench can reach downward into a child's DOM handle.
defects.reproduction: $ grep -rn "ImageDropZone" demo src e2e test → ExtractWorkbench.vue:15,193,222 and nothing else. The defineExpose surface therefore exists SOLELY to serve this one back channel.
defects.proposedCure: useFileDialog() inside useExtractSession, returned as session.openPicker. ExtractControls's @upload and the drop zone's own click both call it. DELETED: defineExpose (:85), openFilePicker (:81-83), fileInputRef (:78), the <input type="file"> (:27-33), onFileSelected (:87-92), ExtractWorkbench.vue:222 and :230-232 — and the ref-vs-useTemplateRef idiom split at ExtractWorkbench.vue:222/223 (edict 7) dies as a side effect.

defects.defect: Hand-rolled drag-state and file-input mechanics that @vueuse/core (an installed direct dependency with 6 existing demo consumers) already owns — and the hand-roll is worse: type validation is enforced on the drop path only, and the drag affordance flickers on child traversal.
defects.evidence: node_modules/@vueuse/core/dist/index.d.ts:1932 `declare function useDropZone(target, options?): UseDropZoneReturn` with UseDropZoneOptions {dataTypes, checkValidity, onDrop, onEnter, onLeave, onOver, multiple, preventDefaultForUnhandled} and UseDropZoneReturn {files, isOverDropZone}; :2626 `declare function useFileDialog(options?): UseFileDialogReturn` with {multiple, accept, capture, reset, directory, initialFiles, input} → {files, open, reset, onChange, onCancel}. Version measured 14.3.0. Six existing consumers: demo/workbenches/gradient/GradientVisualizer/easing/EasingSpecimenStrip.vue:12, demo/picker/ColorPicker.vue:123, demo/shell/dock/Dock.vue:16, demo/color-session/useColorPersistence.ts:2, demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:23, demo/palettes/usePaletteStore.ts:1. The hand-roll: ImageDropZone.vue:78-100 (23 lines) re-deriving isOverDropZone (:79 dragging), accept (:30), dataTypes (:97), reset (:91), open (:82). Divergent validation: :30 accept="image/*" is advisory only — a user switching the native picker to All Files reaches :90 emit("file", file) with NO type check, while the drop path at :97 rejects it. Independently observed at docs/.../wb-extract-controls/challenge-C-implementation.md:104-108.
defects.mechanism: Second implementation of a concept whose home is an installed, already-consumed dependency — and the re-implementation reproduces the two classic failure modes the library exists to prevent (split validation, uncounted dragleave).
defects.reproduction:
Split validation: CONFIRMED by inspection of ImageDropZone.vue:30 vs :97 — accept is advisory, no guard on the onFileSelected path (:87-92). Drag flicker: HYPOTHESIS — mechanism is spec-derived (dragleave on the root fires with relatedTarget = descendant when the pointer moves from root onto the at :37 or
at :46, and :24 unconditionally sets dragging=false, dropping the border-primary/bg-primary-10/scale affordance mid-drag) but NOT reproduced live; native drag synthesis is an expensive probe and the ownership argument stands without it.
defects.proposedCure: useDropZone(rootRef, { dataTypes:['image/*'], multiple:false, onDrop }) + useFileDialog({ accept:'image/*', multiple:false, reset:true }) — the latter hoisted into useExtractSession per L-3. The component's <script setup> drops from 36 lines to ~8 and the two-path validation collapses to one dataTypes declaration.

defects.defect: Wrong public surface: two props encode one state. `disableClick` is a total function of `preview` at the only call site, so 4 declared states have 2 reachable ones — and two rendered branches ship unreachable.
defects.evidence: ImageDropZone.vue:69-72 defineProps<{ preview: string|null; disableClick?: boolean }>(). Single call site derives one from the other: ExtractWorkbench.vue:22-23 `:preview="session.previewDataUrl.value"` / `:disable-click="!!session.previewDataUrl.value"`. Dead branches: :20 the 'Replace image, click or drop a new image' aria-label requires preview && !disableClick — unreachable; :61 the 'replace' corner tag requires the same — the tag can only ever read 'sample' (corroborated at docs/.../wb-extract-workbench/challenge-C-implementation.pass2-2026-07-28.md:372-373); :10 `preview && disableClick ? …` — the && is redundant. Naming defect: :19 `:tabindex="disableClick ? -1 : 0"` silently evicts the drop zone from the tab order the moment an image loads — a keyboard consequence hidden behind a prop named for a mouse concern.
defects.mechanism: A prop minted to express a mode that is already a total function of an existing prop; the redundancy then licenses template branches that can never fire.
defects.reproduction: $ grep -rn "ImageDropZone" demo src e2e test → ExtractWorkbench.vue:15,193,222 only. There is no second call site that could ever pass a different combination; ExtractWorkbench.vue:22-23 pins disableClick === !!preview.
defects.proposedCure: Delete `disableClick`. Public surface becomes props { preview: string|null }, emits { file:[File], sample:[] } (see L-8). Every disableClick read becomes `preview`. The two unreachable branches are DELETED, not preserved — they are residue, not a feature awaiting a caller.

defects.defect: Per-instance inline transition overrides in the only file in the repo that does this — in a project whose root already declares the same values, with the root's own comment demanding "no per-callsite modifier". All three inline declarations measured dead or replaceable by one existing utility class.
defects.evidence: ImageDropZone.vue:17 `:style="{ transitionDuration:'var(--duration-normal)', transitionTimingFunction:'var(--ease-standard)' }"` and :59 `:style="{ transitionDuration:'var(--duration-fast)' }"`. Repo-wide grep for the idiom over demo/ + src/ returns ONLY these two sites plus demo/styles/foundation.css:128-129 which sets `--default-transition-duration: var(--duration-fast)` / `--default-transition-timing-function: var(--ease-standard)`; its comment at :120-127 reads "Alias it at the @theme ROOT … so every un-tuned transition utility speaks the app's fast duration + standard ease by construction — NO PER-CALLSITE MODIFIER." demo/shell/dock/ActionToolbar.vue:9 already ships `duration-normal` as a class in production, proving the utility compiles here.
defects.mechanism: Per-instance styling override where the design system already supplies the value at the root — owner edict 5, and the exact anti-pattern foundation.css was written to abolish.
defects.reproduction: $ node scratchpad/probe-defaults.mjs (playwright, http://localhost:9000/#/extract) → {"bare_transition_all":{"dur":"0.2s","ease":"cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"},"bare_transition_opacity":{"dur":"0.2s","ease":"cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"},"with_duration_normal":{"dur":"0.3s","ease":"cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"},"with_ease_standard":{"dur":"0.2s","ease":"cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"},"rootDefaults":{"d":"0.2s","e":"cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"}} and $ node scratchpad/probe-utils.mjs → live drop zone computes {"transitionDuration":"0.3s","transitionTimingFunction":"cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"}. Therefore: :17 duration → replaceable by class `duration-normal` (measured identical 0.3s); :17 timing-function → DEAD, identical to root default; :59 duration → DEAD, bare transition-opacity is already 0.2s.
defects.proposedCure: :17 → append `duration-normal` to the existing :class array and delete the :style binding entirely. :59 → delete the :style binding entirely, no replacement. Net: two Vue bindings and three CSS declarations removed, zero visual change (measured identical).

defects.defect: useExtractSession hand-rolls a debounce one hop under the component, beside demo/shared/utils.ts which is documented as "The demo's ONE debounce" and has seven consumers.
defects.evidence: demo/workbenches/extract/composables/useExtractSession.ts:49 (`let debounceTimer`), :159-162 (debouncedReQuantize: clearTimeout + setTimeout(runQuantize, 300)), :194-196 (manual onBeforeUnmount cleanup). Home: demo/shared/utils.ts:23 with comment "The demo's ONE debounce (T.W6.5 Lane M · row 12 — the root-barrel shed) … one pending timer, last-args-win, .cancel() drops a pending invocation." The hand-roll reproduces those semantics exactly, plus a manual onBeforeUnmount that .cancel() already serves.
defects.mechanism: Dual path — a second implementation of a concept with a named, documented, seven-consumer home.
defects.reproduction: $ grep -rn 'from ".*shared/utils"' demo/ → 7 sites: demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:33, demo/color-session/useColorNameResolution.ts:2, useColorParsing.ts:2, useColorPersistence.ts:3, useColorPipeline.ts:2, useColorUrl.ts:8, demo/workbenches/gradient/GradientVisualizer/GradientCodeEditor.vue:3. useExtractSession.ts is NOT among them (its imports at :13-18 contain no shared/utils edge) yet contains debounceTimer at :49.
defects.proposedCure: `const reQuantize = debounce(runQuantize, 300)` from ../../../shared/utils; `onBeforeUnmount(reQuantize.cancel)`. Four lines and one module-scope `let` die.

defects.defect: Three outward channels for one component, and the load-bearing one is undeclared: the eyedropper opens via a native click riding attribute fallthrough that defineEmits does not name, splitting the click state machine across two files.
defects.evidence: Channel 1 declared: ImageDropZone.vue:74-76 defineEmits<{ file: [file: File] }>(). Channel 2 declared but wrong (L-3): :85 defineExpose({ openFilePicker }). Channel 3 UNDECLARED: ExtractWorkbench.vue:25 `@click="session.previewDataUrl.value && (eyedropperActive = true)"` merges with the component's own root handler at ImageDropZone.vue:21 `@click="!disableClick && openFilePicker()"`. Both bind the same root <div>; the component sets no inheritAttrs:false. Because disableClick === !!preview (L-5), exactly one fires per state — the state machine lives half in each file. Nothing in ImageDropZone's declared API says it emits a sampling intent; a reader of the SFC cannot know the eyedropper exists.
defects.mechanism: An implicit contract carried by attribute fallthrough instead of an explicit emit.
defects.reproduction: The two line-refs (ImageDropZone.vue:21, ExtractWorkbench.vue:25); behaviour follows directly from Vue's attrs-merge semantics for a single-root component with no inheritAttrs:false.
defects.proposedCure: Declare it. emits: { file: [File], sample: [] }; :21 becomes `@click="preview ? emit('sample') : openPicker()"`; ExtractWorkbench.vue:25 becomes `@sample="eyedropperActive = true"`. One root, one declared surface, no fallthrough dependence.

defects.defect: tsconfig.demo.json's @mkbabb/value.js `paths` block is a second, drifted declaration of the published surface — two dead names, two missing keys, one dangling file target, stale prose — and is fully redundant with the exports-map self-reference that actually does the resolution.
defects.evidence: package.json exports = {./color, ./value, ./css, ./easing, ./math, ./transform, ./quantize} (7 keys; src/subpaths/ = color.ts css.ts easing.ts math.ts quantize.ts transform.ts value.ts). tsconfig.demo.json paths = {color, parsing, math, easing, units, transform, quantize} + bare. Therefore: `./parsing` and `./units` are DEAD (no exports key, no src/subpaths file); `./css` (10 demo consumers) and `./value` are MISSING; `"@mkbabb/value.js": ["./dist/index.d.ts"]` targets a file that does not exist — `$ ls dist/` → `anchors-C_wdoOYd.js gh-pages operations-CB_1wGy4.js result-CZJK1CwL.js subpaths` (no index.d.ts); and the surrounding comment says "the 8 public keys" / "a CLOSED 8-key set" when there are 7. Redundancy proven by trace: `$ npx tsc -p tsconfig.demo.json --noEmit --traceResolution | sed -n '407,421p'` → "'paths' option is specified, looking for a pattern to match module name '@mkbabb/value.js/css'. … Found 'package.json' at '…/value.js/package.json'. Entering conditional exports. Matched 'exports' condition 'types'. Using 'exports' subpath './css' with target './dist/subpaths/css.d.ts'. … successfully resolved to '…/dist/subpaths/css.d.ts' with Package ID '@mkbabb/value.js/dist/subpaths/css.d.ts@4.0.0'." — ./css has NO paths entry and resolves correctly anyway, via package self-reference, to the same target the five present entries hard-code.
defects.mechanism: The published surface declared twice — once normatively in package.json#exports (which vite.config.ts:38-49 GENERATES its runtime alias set from, explicitly "so the alias set can never drift from the exports map"), once by hand in tsconfig.demo.json — with no gate binding them. It has already drifted.
defects.reproduction: The three-column table verified by `ls src/subpaths/`, `node -e` over both package.json files, and `ls dist/`; plus the pasted --traceResolution block. One live trap remains a HYPOTHESIS (not reproduced): a stray `@mkbabb/value.js/parsing` or `/units` import matches a paths pattern pointing at a nonexistent .d.ts before falling through to an exports map with no such key — failure mode is a resolution error, not a silent wrong resolve, so the risk is confusion, not corruption.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the @mkbabb/value.js* entries from tsconfig.demo.json#paths outright and let self-reference through exports be the single source of truth — the same single-source discipline vite.config.ts:38-49 already applies on the runtime side. Keep the vue/@vue/* dedupe entries. Fix the stale "8 public keys" prose to 7.

defects.defect: glass-ui ships no drop-zone / file-field primitive, so edict 4 (primitives belong in glass-ui) has no home to point at today — and filing the producer ask now, at one consumer, would itself be the contrivance edict 3 prohibits.
defects.evidence: $ node -e "const d=require('./node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/package.json'); console.log(d.version); console.log(Object.keys(d.exports).length)" → 7.0.0 / 73 export keys, none named drop-zone or file-field. $ head -5 node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/forms.d.ts → exports only ./components/input, ./components/textarea, ./components/combobox, useUserInvalidAria, ControlSize. No near-miss whose component-type name should be reused. ImageDropZone has exactly one consumer (ExtractWorkbench.vue:15).
defects.mechanism: A design-system primitive with a legitimate producer home that does not yet exist, at a consumer count below the threshold where minting it is warranted.
defects.reproduction: NONE — this is a booked trigger condition, not a present defect.
defects.proposedCure: Leave it where it is. Record the ask so the SECOND consumer, not the first, triggers the glass-ui letter. Should any repair in this family touch the component's rendered surface, the standing BH/BI relay edict applies (every component/glass-ui-level change relayed to the active glass-ui BH inbox).

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation defects in demo/workbenches/generate/GeneratePane.vue (and its sole child GenerateControls.vue + composable useColorGeneration.ts)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m]) — the tier this seat was explicitly spawned with; not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: C-2 — the per-swatch copy verb is wholly dead AND the pane's entire generated output is erased from the accessibility tree. glass-ui 7.0.0's WatercolorDot has no `tag` prop, is `inheritAttrs:false` reading only class/style from useAttrs, and renders a hardcoded `<span aria-hidden="true">` with inline `pointer-events:none`. GenerateControls.vue:199-208 passes `tag="button"`, `:aria-label`, and `@click` — all three are silently discarded. Measured live: tagName SPAN, aria-hidden true, pointer-events none, tabIndex -1, own-centre hit-test resolves elsewhere, `clipboard.writeText` call count 0 after a forced click (control button writes fine), SWATCH KEYBOARD-REACHABLE false, and the plate's aria snapshot contains zero colors. `tag="button"` was authored at a61094e3 in the glass-5 era; the glass-7 adoption f2c8f565 never migrated the consumer. Six further demo sites carry the same dead prop.
result.negativeProof: N/A — verdict is DEFECTIVE. (Recorded positives that make the negatives load-bearing: useColorGeneration.ts is four refs + one computed over a pure mulberry32 generator with NO rAF/watch/listener/timer, so the pane is not part of the PRM-RAF epidemic; no ValueUnit wrapping, no defineModel, no HSV round-trip, no parseCssColor, no WebGL, no network — the four named local hazard classes do not apply; GeneratePane.vue has no mounted hook/observer/subscription, so nothing leaks under KeepAlive max=6; verbatimModuleSyntax is satisfied at every type-only import across all three files; the plate's `region "Generated palette"` landmark resolves correctly and namelessButtons is 0 on /#/generate in all four Safari matrices; o20's seed-exactness law genuinely holds and the preview strips do not lie; the "SelectContent unmounts closed, so zero rest cost" comment at GenerateControls.vue:88-93 is TRUE — the closed-pane aria snapshot has no listbox, so I looked for a per-tick generation storm and did not find one; REPORT.md shows overflowX 0, pageErr 0, consoleErr 0 on /#/generate in all four matrices.)

defects.defect: The palette name the user types is silently discarded on every save. GenerateControls.vue:48-50 declares `save: [colors: string[], name: string]` and :103 emits both arguments; GeneratePane.vue:14 declares `onSave(colors: string[])` (one parameter) and :19 hardcodes `pm.createPalette("Generated Palette", paletteColors)`. The editable, aria-labelled `Palette name` input at GenerateControls.vue:144-149 is functionally dead.
defects.evidence: demo/workbenches/generate/GeneratePane.vue:14,19 vs demo/workbenches/generate/GenerateControls.vue:48-50,103. Live probe output: `default name value: "Generated Palette" / typed name value: "MY-CUSTOM-NAME-42" / localStorage: [{"name":"Generated Palette","slug":"generated-palette-17a2ab30","n":5}] / VERDICT: NAME DROPPED`. TS proof the compiler cannot catch it: `type SaveEmit=(c:string[],n:string)=>void; const onSave=(c:string[])=>{}; const h:SaveEmit=onSave;` → `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --ignoreConfig t.ts; echo exit=$?` → `exit=0`.
defects.mechanism: Emit-arity truncation: a handler with fewer parameters is assignable to a listener type with more, so vue-tsc is structurally blind. Compounded by a duplicated default literal — "Generated Palette" is authored independently at GenerateControls.vue:52 and GeneratePane.vue:19, so at rest the stored name matches the untouched default and the bug only surfaces once a user edits, which no gate does.
defects.reproduction: node /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js/docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/wb-generate-pane/probes/c1-name-drop.mjs (against the live dev server at http://localhost:9000): clears localStorage, opens Generate, fills the `Palette name` textbox with MY-CUSTOM-NAME-42, clicks `Save palette`, reads localStorage['color-palettes'].
defects.proposedCure: Architectural, not a patch: the name is palette state, not chrome state. Move `paletteName` into useColorGeneration() alongside preset/harmony/count/seed so there is ONE owner — that deletes the emit payload, deletes the second literal, and deletes the pane's pass-through handler, leaving no argument to truncate. Minimum patch if the emit must survive as the seam: `onSave(colors: string[], name: string)` + `pm.createPalette(name, paletteColors)`, with the default literal existing exactly once.

defects.defect: The per-swatch copy verb is entirely dead — no click, no accessible name, no keyboard reach, aria-hidden — and as a consequence the pane's entire generated output is absent from the accessibility tree. GenerateControls.vue:199-208 passes `tag="button"`, `:aria-label="Copy ${css}"` and `@click="copyColor(css)"` to glass-ui 7's WatercolorDot, which supports none of them. `copyColor()` (GenerateControls.vue:111-113) is dead code; `cursor-pointer`, `active:scale-95` and `focus-visible:outline-none` on the same element are all inert.
defects.evidence: node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui@7.0.0/dist/watercolor-dot.js — props are exactly color|variant|animate|cycleDuration|range|seed (no `tag`), `inheritAttrs: !1`, setup reads only `n.class`/`n.style` from useAttrs(), root is a hardcoded `<span … "aria-hidden":"true" …>` with `pointerEvents:"none"` in its inline style object. Live measurement: `{"tagName":"SPAN","attrs":["aria-hidden=\"true\"",…],"pointerEvents":"none","outlineStyle":"none","hitTestIsSwatch":false,"tabIndexProp":-1}`; `after clicking swatch #1 (force:true) → clipboard.writeText calls: []` while the control `Copy all colors` button wrote `["oklch(77.36…deg), …"]`; `SWATCH KEYBOARD-REACHABLE: false`; plate aria snapshot = `region "Generated palette": textbox "Palette name"; text "5"; button "Regenerate"; button "Save palette"; button "Copy all colors"; paragraph "seed: 1e933539"` — zero colors. Provenance: `git log --oneline -S 'tag="button"' -- demo/workbenches/generate/GenerateControls.vue` → a61094e3 (glass-5 era); `git log --oneline --follow -- .../GeneratePane.vue | head -1` → f2c8f565 (glass-ui 7.0.0 adoption).
defects.mechanism: Unmigrated consumer of a breaking design-system change. The glass-7 adoption swapped the primitive to a decorative, aria-hidden, pointer-events:none span and the consumer's glass-5-era `tag="button"` + listener + aria-label were left standing. Vue attr fallthrough plus `inheritAttrs:false` means the compiler cannot see it and the runtime cannot complain. Same class at six further demo sites (SwatchHoverMenu.vue:17,32; CurrentPaletteEditor.vue:98; MixSourceSelector.vue:168,215 are the other `tag="button"`+@click seats).
defects.reproduction: node /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js/docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/wb-generate-pane/probes/c2-swatch-dom.mjs — dumps the .generate-swatch DOM + computed style + hit test, takes an aria snapshot of [data-generate-plate], monkey-patches navigator.clipboard.writeText, force-clicks swatch #1 (zero writes) then the Copy-all button (one write) as a control, and walks the tab order from the name input.
defects.proposedCure: glass-ui 7's WatercolorDot is a decorative face by its own docstring and declares that by rendering aria-hidden + pointer-events:none. Wrap it in a real `<button aria-label="Copy {css}">` — a seat plus a face, the composition the primitive's contract implies. If the register truly requires the dot itself to be the interactive seat, that is a request for a polymorphic `as`/`tag` prop IN GLASS-UI (edict 4: primitives live in the design system), never a consumer attribute the primitive throws away. Either way replace `focus-visible:outline-none` with a real indicator on whatever the focusable seat becomes. Sweep the six sibling sites in the same wave.

defects.defect: Vacuous gate. No test anywhere mounts GeneratePane, GenerateControls, or useColorGeneration. The only e2e oracle asserts button VISIBILITY, that the seed text changes, and that a preset row's stamped data-stops equals the swatches' computed backgroundColor — it certifies a control surface it never operates.
defects.evidence: `grep -rln "GenerateControls\|useColorGeneration\|GeneratePane" test/ e2e/ demo/test/` → no matches under any test root (hits are the source files, demo/DESIGN.md, demo/shell/usePaneRouter.ts only). `grep -rn "Save palette\|createPalette\|copyColor\|Copy all colors" test/ e2e/ demo/test/` → only e2e/smoke/oracles/o20-generate-plate.spec.ts:48,51, both `toBeVisible()` assertions. The oracle's own assertions: :33-52 visibility/containment, :56-60 seed text changes, :98-105 `.generate-swatch` computed backgroundColor equality.
defects.mechanism: The oracle was written to guard a DESIGN law (the preview strip must not lie) and does that faithfully via getComputedStyle — the one property that survives the interactive register decaying into an aria-hidden decorative span. Behaviour, storage, roles, names and the dock action path are unasserted, so implementation rot is invisible to CI.
defects.reproduction: NONE (this is an enumeration finding, proved by the two greps above). Mutations that keep the entire suite green: M1 empty the body of onSave in GeneratePane.vue:14-20; M2 delete `@click="copyColor(css)"` + `:aria-label` from GenerateControls.vue:199-208 and delete copyColor; M3 delete GeneratePane.vue:22-26 defineExpose entirely; M4 hardcode a different literal in createPalette.
defects.proposedCure: Three cheap oracles: (1) save round-trip — type a name, click Save, read localStorage['color-palettes'], assert palettes[0].name equals what was typed and colors equal the live swatches (kills C-1/M1/M4); (2) swatch verb — `plate.getByRole("button", { name: /^Copy / })` count === palette.length, click one, assert the clipboard (kills C-2/M2; the role query alone fails today); (3) action-bar parity — drive the dock's Regenerate/Save at BOTH mobile and desktop viewports and assert identical effects (kills C-3/M3).

defects.defect: The dock action bar's Generate verbs (Regenerate / Save palette / Copy colors) are silent no-ops on mobile. The pane's own in-plate buttons work at every size; the exposed action surface does not.
defects.evidence: Live measurement, one clean context per breakpoint, clicking the dock button by DOM identity (never the plate's): `[mobile-390] DOCK Regenerate: seed: 4b1ccfcd -> seed: 4b1ccfcd :: DEAD (silent no-op)`, `[mobile-390] DOCK Save (clicked) -> localStorage: NULL :: DEAD (silent no-op)`, `[desktop-1440] DOCK Regenerate: seed: 9368cd40 -> seed: be6170e8 :: WORKS`, `[desktop-1440] DOCK Save -> WROTE {"version":1,"palettes":[…]}`; `pageErrors: (none)`. Control: `IN-PLATE Regenerate: seed: c9ba611d -> seed: a28ecf52 WORKS` at 390. Sites: demo/color-picker/App.vue:83-91 (mobile PaneSlot, no :on-mount) vs :101,:127 (desktop slots, both have it); App.vue:317 generatePaneRef; demo/shell/usePaneRouter.ts:106 `generate: Ref<any>`; usePaneRouter.ts:196-198 `paneRefs.generate.value?.regenerate?.()`; GeneratePane.vue:23-25 `controlsRef.value?.regenerate?.()`.
defects.mechanism: Four optional-chain guards in series over an `any`-typed template ref. The mobile PaneSlot never populates generatePaneRef, `Ref<any>` erases the pane→dock contract so nothing typechecks, and the doubled `?.` at both the router and the pane converts the broken wire into silence. This is the standing no-masking-fallbacks edict violated four times in five lines; `gradient` and `mix` ride the identical wire.
defects.reproduction: node /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js/docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/wb-generate-pane/probes/c3b-dock-action-wiring.mjs — for viewport 390x844 (isMobile) and 1440x900: open /#/generate, click `Toggle action bar`, locate the Regenerate/Save buttons NOT inside [data-generate-plate], click them, and compare the plate's seed text and localStorage before/after.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the imperative expose. The pane already lives in a provide/inject world — it injects LIBRARY_PORT_KEY at :11 from the five-port surface usePalettePorts establishes. Hoist useColorGeneration() to the pane and provide it (or add a GENERATE_PORT_KEY beside the existing five) so the dock action bar calls the SAME typed functions the plate calls: no template ref, no InstanceType, no `any`, no `?.`, and no mobile/desktop fork, because a provided port does not care which PaneSlot mounted the component. Retire PaneActionRefs/Ref<any> for gradient and mix in the same sweep.

defects.defect: Three state-changing outcomes with zero feedback: Regenerate replaces the whole palette with no aria-live announcement; Save writes to localStorage, discards the returned Palette, and renders no confirmation; copyColors discards writeClipboard's discriminated CopyResult so a failed copy is indistinguishable from a successful one.
defects.evidence: GeneratePane.vue:19 discards createPalette's return. GenerateControls.vue:106-108 `async function copyColors() { await writeClipboard(palette.value.join(", ")); }` — result unused. The contract at node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/composables/dom/useClipboard.d.ts:37 is `writeClipboard(text): Promise<CopyResult>` with `CopyResult = {ok:true} | {ok:false, reason}`, documented as "returns the discriminated result … rather than a lossy boolean". The plate's aria snapshot (see C-2) contains no status/alert/live region. The repo already knows better: demo/color-picker/App.vue:365 uses `useClipboard({ resetMs: 2000 })` and drives a visible `linkCopied` off `status`. Aggravation: usePaletteStore.ts:66-81 dedups on (name.toLowerCase(), colorsMatch), so with the constant name from C-1, pressing Save twice without regenerating is a genuine no-op with no feedback.
defects.mechanism: Feedback was never given a seat in the plate. The component reaches for the low-level primitive (writeClipboard) instead of the scope-owning composable (useClipboard) the design system provides and the app already uses elsewhere, and throws the discriminated result away.
defects.reproduction: NONE for the failure branch specifically (a clipboard rejection was not induced) — the discarded-result and absent-live-region facts are direct source/DOM readings; the silent-save behaviour is visible in the c1-name-drop.mjs run, where the palette lands in localStorage with no UI change.
defects.proposedCure: One `aria-live="polite"` status seat inside the plate that states the generated colors and the outcome of save/copy, fed by glass-ui's useClipboard `status` rather than the bare primitive. This single addition also discharges C-2's missing text alternative — the generated result becomes readable and the outcomes become announced in one construct.

defects.defect: GeneratePane injects CSS_COLOR_KEY with a non-null assertion and never uses it — a phantom dependency in a 41-line file.
defects.evidence: demo/workbenches/generate/GeneratePane.vue:7 (`import { CSS_COLOR_KEY } from "../../color-session/keys"`) and :10 (`const cssColorOpaque = inject(CSS_COLOR_KEY)!;`). The identifier `cssColorOpaque` occurs exactly once in the file — its own declaration. It appears in neither the script body nor the template (lines 29-40).
defects.mechanism: Dead injection retained through the W43b port dissolution / W44 glass adoption. The `!` makes the miss unfalsifiable: if the provider is ever removed the line still typechecks and still yields `undefined` silently, so the composition graph misstates what the pane needs and no gate can notice.
defects.reproduction: NONE needed — direct file reading; the identifier has exactly one occurrence in a 41-line file.
defects.proposedCure: Delete lines 7 and 10. Separately, the sibling `inject(LIBRARY_PORT_KEY)!` at :11 IS used but carries the same `!`; under C-3's cure the pane stops being a manual injection site altogether. (Latent, labelled hypothesis: pm.createPalette throws TypeError if the pane is ever mounted outside providePalettePorts — not reproduced, because no such mount site exists today.)

defects.defect: Not Vue 3.5 idiom: a string template ref captured with `ref<InstanceType<typeof GenerateControls> | null>(null)` where the house idiom is `useTemplateRef`.
defects.evidence: demo/workbenches/generate/GeneratePane.vue:12 `const controlsRef = ref<InstanceType<typeof GenerateControls> | null>(null);` with `ref="controlsRef"` at :36. The correct idiom in this same codebase: demo/color-picker/App.vue:301 `const dockNav = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>("dockNav");`.
defects.mechanism: Pre-3.5 template-ref pattern surviving the migration; edict 7 (idiomatic Vue 3.5).

result.strongestDefect: C1 — Drop-to-upload does not work. ImageDropZone.vue binds @dragover.prevent and @drop.prevent but never cancels `dragenter`, so Chromium never accepts a drag update that changes the drag target element, and a release on such an update is never delivered as a `drop` event. In the EMPTY state the zone's interior is a stack of independently hit-testable children (placeholder div :46, svg icon :47, prompt span :48), so ordinary pointer travel crosses targets constantly and the gesture "drag a file in, move across the zone, release" fails every time — silently, with no error line and no live region. Measured with real CDP-generated drag events: shipped G1 dropEventsDelivered 0 / previewNaturalW null; the identical gesture with one injected line `zone.addEventListener("dragenter", e => e.preventDefault())` gives dropEventsDelivered 1 / previewNaturalW 64. The component's headline affordance ("Drop an image or click to browse") is inoperative in exactly the state where dropping is the only thing offered.
result.negativeProof: n/a — verdict is DEFECTIVE. Negatives established alongside (each with positive evidence, so the next seat does not re-litigate): (1) No leak surface — the SFC registers no listener/observer/timer/rAF/WebGL outside the template and its entire reactive state is one ref<boolean>; grep for addEventListener|requestAnimationFrame|setInterval|setTimeout|new .*Observer over the file returns no matches, so the KeepAlive/onBeforeUnmount hazard ledgered at DEFECT-LEDGER.md:8195 for the extract subtree does not reach this file. (2) `scale-[1.01]` DOES render — I nearly filed a false positive: getComputedStyle().transform is "none" because Tailwind v4 emits the `scale` property, and an immediate read of `scale` returns "1" because transition-all is mid-flight; settled read at +600ms (evidence/idz-probe12.mjs) gives {scale:"1.01", transform:"none", transitionDuration:"0.3s"} and the CSSOM rule `.scale-\[1\.01\] { scale: 1.01; }` exists. (3) Zero contribution to the measured a11y counts on /#/extract — REPORT.json's six smallTapTargets are the 160x23 slug input, three 22x22 slug-bar buttons and the two 12x24 slider thumbs; the zone measures 462x180/462x320 and always carries an aria-label, so it is neither a small target nor one of the 3 namelessButtons. (4) verbatimModuleSyntax clean — both imports are value imports, no type-only import to mark. (5) input.value="" runs after the synchronous emit, so re-selecting the same file works; not a stale-read defect. (6) The known local hazards (defineModel async round-trip, ValueUnit nesting, oklch->HSV hue drift, reka-ui slider pointer capture) do not apply — the component holds no model, wraps no value, parses no colour and mounts no slider; checked, not assumed.

defects.defect: Drop-to-upload is inoperative in the empty state: the root never cancels `dragenter`, so Chromium does not deliver `drop` when the release lands on a drag update that changed the drag target element. Silent — no error line, no live region, no state change.
defects.evidence: demo/workbenches/extract/ImageDropZone.vue:23-25 (@dragover.prevent + @drop.prevent, no dragenter handler); children at :46-48 are independently hit-testable. MEASURED (evidence/idz-probe6.mjs, real CDP Input.dispatchDragEvent): G1_shipped_travelThenRelease -> {"dropEventsDelivered":0,"previewNaturalW":null,"errorLine":null}, trace `dragEnter@P1 -> dragenter@ROOT / dragOver@P1 -> dragover@ROOT / dragOver@P2 -> dragenter@span.prompt + dragleave@ROOT / dragOver@P3 -> dragenter@svg.icon + dragleave@span.prompt / drop@P2 -> dragenter@span.prompt + dragleave@svg.icon` (no drop). G2_cured_travelThenRelease (identical gesture + one injected line `zone.addEventListener("dragenter", e => e.preventDefault())`) -> {"dropEventsDelivered":1,"previewNaturalW":64} with `drop@P2 -> drop@span.prompt`. G3_shipped_stillPointer and G4_shipped_replaceOverPreview both -> 1 drop / naturalWidth 64. Canon: MDN 'HTML Drag and Drop API - Define a drop zone' requires preventDefault() in BOTH the dragenter and dragover handlers.
defects.mechanism: drag-target-crossing: only `dragover` is cancelled, so any drag update that changes the target element is not accepted and the following release is never dispatched as `drop`; the zone's own children guarantee the crossings
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/wb-extract-imagedropzone/evidence/idz-probe6.mjs — compare G1_shipped_travelThenRelease.dropEventsDelivered (0, no preview) with G2_cured_travelThenRelease (1, naturalWidth 64). defects.proposedCure: Transposition, not patch: the zone is trying to be a drop target AND a container of independently hit-testable children. Make it one thing — `pointer-events: none` on every child of the drop surface, so the root is the only drag target and no crossing ever occurs; that single declaration cures C1 and C2 together and adds no handler, no module, no wrapper. Add `@dragenter.prevent` regardless, because the spec requires it to make the target valid on first entry.

Simultaneously make the specimen readable — a named list whose items announce their color values — so the pane's output exists in text. Removing tag="button" alone would leave a silent specimen; the seat must be added in the same move.

defects.defect: Three verbs occupy six seats: the plate chrome duplicates the Dock action bar's Regenerate/Save/Copy, and the copy verb ships under two different accessible names.
defects.evidence: usePaneRouter.ts:194-199 defines the Dock actions ("Regenerate", "Save palette", "Copy colors") wired to GeneratePane.vue:22-26's defineExpose; GenerateControls.vue:156-185 renders the same three again in the plate ("Regenerate", "Save palette", "Copy all colors"). Live census: {"duplicateAccessibleNames":{"Regenerate":1,"Save palette":2,"Copy all colors":1,"Color count":2},"regenBtnCount":2,"regenOwners":["dock/other","plate"]}. A Playwright click on button[aria-label='Save palette'] fails with `locator resolved to 2 elements`. Canon: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §4 PR-06 ("Three adjacent action species ... REMOVE ... One action/selection owner across Generate"); OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md §3 Generate close ("one Dock action species"); VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §5 ("Commit uses one glass-ui action set").
defects.mechanism: F4 state never designed — the plate chrome was authored without retiring the pre-existing Dock bar, so both survived. The defineExpose imperative bridge exists solely to serve the duplicate.
defects.reproduction: node probe: webkit 1440x900, #/generate, count elements matching [aria-label] against the verb names; attempt page.click("button[aria-label='Save palette']") — fails with a 2-element ambiguity.
defects.proposedCure: Pick one owner and delete the other outright (no dual path — edict 2). Under D-1's chassis the commit region is a first-class chassis region, so the plate chrome is the natural survivor and usePaneRouter.ts's `view === "generate"` actionBar branch plus GeneratePane's defineExpose bridge both go. Whichever survives, normalise the copy verb to one name.

defects.defect: Two facts are rendered four times simultaneously: the generated colors appear as both a full-bleed strip and a WatercolorDot row, and the count appears as both a Badge and a slider label.
defects.evidence: GenerateControls.vue:135 `<PaletteColorStrip :colors="stripColors">` and :199-208 the `<WatercolorDot v-for>` row — same `palette` array, two geometries. :150-152 `<Badge>{{ count }}</Badge>` and :287-291 `<label>{{ count }}</label>`. Measured at 390x844 with count=12: {"dotCount":12,"dotRows":[452,494],"stripSegments":12,"stripSegW":26.83,"badge":"12","labels":["12"]} — twelve colors as 26.83px strip segments and again as 36px dots on two ragged rows 60px below, with no registration between them (see scratchpad/gen-390-max.png). Canon: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 card law 5 and VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §3 law 8 ("Supporting fixtures do not compete with it through equal size").
defects.mechanism: F4 state never designed — each rendering was added for a different job (strip = card-family specimen face, dots = copy seats) and neither was retired when the other landed; the count Badge duplicates the slider that owns the count.
defects.reproduction: node probe: webkit 390x844, #/generate, focus [role='slider'] and press ArrowRight x8 to reach count=12, then measure the strip's child count/widths against the .generate-swatch rects and read both count texts. Output pasted above.
defects.proposedCure: Canon already picked the winner — OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md §3 names the Generate protagonist as the "WatercolorDot specimen". Delete the strip and let the dot field be the 61.8% stage; the count Badge dies with it, leaving the slider's own label as the count's single owner.

defects.defect: The count slider's color track is hand-rolled around the design system — a bare gradient div plus a per-instance `--slider-track-bg: transparent` override — producing a transparent-filled thumb whose ring measures 1.19:1 against its own track at preset=Pastel, and a color surface that escapes the forced-colors roster.
defects.evidence: GenerateControls.vue:292-296 `<div class="absolute inset-0 rounded-full overflow-hidden h-6" :style="{ background: countSliderGradient }" />` and :305 `:style="{ '--slider-track-bg': 'transparent' }"`. Measured thumb: background-color rgba(0,0,0,0), border-color rgb(251,250,248). Ring-vs-track contrast, live: vibrant [2.76,1.72,3.75,2.35,3.34]; PASTEL [1.45,1.19,1.62,1.37,1.56], min 1.19:1 (WCAG 1.4.11 floor is 3:1); visually confirmed in scratchpad/gen-pastel.png. Roster gap: demo/styles/foundation.css:679-698 lists `.glass-slider[data-variant="spectrum"] .slider-range` as the tier-1 forced-color-adjust:none surface; the substitute div carries no roster class and no data-color-surface. Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §5 ("The domain-neutral axis composition sits over BI Slider ... Generate count ... adopt that one composition; feature waves own their domain arrangement, not new slider mechanics") and §4.1 ("Text, focus, boundaries and state meet their rendered contrast on the actual material tier"). Owner edicts 4 and 5.
defects.mechanism: F3 reached past the design system — hand-rolling the producer's color-bearing track walks outside every guarantee the producer surface carries: contrast, WHCM roster membership, and token ownership. Because the track is arbitrary user-generated color, NO fixed ring color can satisfy 3:1; the failure is architectural, not a color choice.
defects.reproduction: node probe: webkit 1440x900, #/generate; resolve each .generate-swatch background and the [role='slider'] borderTopColor through a 1x1 canvas 2D context and compute WCAG contrast; then open [aria-label='Generation preset'], select the Pastel option, and re-measure. Output pasted above.
defects.proposedCure: Push the color-bearing track into glass-ui: a producer `track-gradient` (or `stops`) input on Slider with a producer-owned thumb whose ring carries its own contrast guarantee against arbitrary track color (dual-stroke light/dark halo), and add that surface to the forced-colors roster once. Delete the div and the inline variable from the consumer. This is exactly edict 4's boundary — the variant belongs in glass-ui, not in the workbench.

defects.defect: The plate's action chrome outweighs its specimen 2.4:1 at the default desktop viewport and 4.8:1 at 200% zoom, because a flex-wrap + ml-auto + shrink-0 verb cluster has no stable rest state and wraps at 1440 — not at 390 as the source comment claims.
defects.evidence: Measured 1440x900: {"chromeRowH":96.5,"stripH":40,"plateH":219.5} and cluster wrapped:true at 1440 (cluster.x 123.98 at 390 leaves ~78px of dead space to its left). Measured at documentElement.style.zoom=2: {"plateW":700,"chromeRowH":193,"overflowPastPlate":-26,"docHScroll":0} — 193px of action chrome against a 40px specimen (scratchpad/gen-zoom200.png). GenerateControls.vue:139-142 comment predicts the wrap "at 390"; GenerateControls.vue:143 `flex flex-wrap` + :156 `ml-auto ... shrink-0`. Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §3 law 8 ("One pane may have one full-strength visual protagonist. Supporting fixtures do not compete with it through equal size or equal shadow").
defects.mechanism: F1 wrong primitive — a 3-button shrink-0 cluster inside a ~460px column makes row height a discontinuous function of viewport width, with the discontinuity landing right at the default desktop size. The authoring comment documents an intent the code does not produce.
defects.reproduction: node probe: webkit 1440x900, #/generate, measure plate.children[1] (chrome row) and plate.children[0] (strip) heights; then set document.documentElement.style.zoom='2', wait, and re-measure.
defects.proposedCure: Under D-1's chassis the commit set is a chassis action REGION with producer-owned --instrument-control-padding/-gap, not a wrapping flex line, so the discontinuity disappears by construction. Do not fix by adding a breakpoint — PR-33 forbids consumer padding/breakpoint copies of the six S122 properties.

defects.defect: Control labels render in the mono/value voice: `.section-label` resolves to Fira Code uppercase caption, where the closed type matrix assigns controls and labels to text-small non-bold Plus Jakarta Sans and reserves Fira Code for value/code/provenance.
defects.evidence: GenerateControls.vue:221,255 `Preset|Harmony`. Definition: node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/styles/typography/utilities.css -> `.section-label { @apply text-mono-caption; color: var(--muted-foreground); }` (text-mono-caption = font-mono + --type-caption + caps tracking + uppercase). Measured live: {"text":"Preset","font":"\"Fira Code\"","size":"12.179px","transform":"uppercase","tracking":"1.2179px"}. Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4 ("control or label, including dropdown options -> text-small, Plus Jakarta Sans, non-bold"; "value, code, or provenance -> text-mono-small") declared closed "across all eighteen compositions"; PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 card law 13 repeats it. Same family: GenerateControls.vue:288 count label is `text-mono-small font-bold` — mono roles carry no bold in the matrix.
defects.mechanism: F3 reached past the design system — a convenience recipe was adopted for a role the matrix assigns elsewhere, inverting the hierarchy so the LABEL reads as data (tracked uppercase monospace) while the VALUE reads as chrome (plain sans in the select trigger).
defects.reproduction: node probe: webkit 1440x900, #/generate, getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.section-label')) -> fontFamily/fontSize/textTransform/letterSpacing. Output pasted above.
defects.proposedCure: Map control labels to the matrix role (text-small, Plus Jakarta Sans, non-bold) at the root — i.e. fix `.section-label`'s role assignment in glass-ui typography rather than per-instance in the eight demo consumers, so the correction lands once for the whole family (edict 5).

defects.defect: The seed provenance line — the pane's only textual record of the specimen and its only reproducibility affordance — renders at 3.19:1 against an opaque plate background, failing WCAG AA (4.5:1) for 14px text.
defects.evidence: GenerateControls.vue:212 `class="px-3 pb-2.5 pt-1 text-mono-small text-muted-foreground tabular-nums select-all"`. Measured live (light scheme, opaque surface — no translucency involved): seed color rgb(112,89,66) at fontSize 14px Fira Code; plate backgroundColor oklab(0.913299 0.005463 0.013024); computed contrast 3.19:1. 14px is not large text (AA large = 18.66px bold / 24px), so the floor is 4.5:1. Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4.1 ("Text, focus, boundaries and state meet their rendered contrast on the actual material tier; a token name is not evidence").
defects.mechanism: F4 state never designed — muted-foreground was applied for visual quietness on a well surface without measuring the resulting ratio; the design intent ("a bench note") was expressed as opacity rather than as size/placement.
defects.reproduction:
node probe: webkit 1440x900, #/generate, read getComputedStyle of the plate's

(color, fontSize) and of [data-generate-plate] (backgroundColor), compute WCAG contrast. Result 3.19.
defects.proposedCure: Do not merely darken the token per-instance. Give provenance its own canon-legal ink level at the well tier once (a rostered provenance color that measures >=4.5:1 on --bg-well in both schemes), and under D-1's transposition give the seed a real home in the chassis inspector where it is provenance for the model, not the faintest ink on the specimen plate.

defects.defect: The palette-name input has no designed rest, focus, truncation, or error state: its only rest affordance is hover-only (dead on touch), its focus indicator is a 40%-alpha ring plus a hard rectangular box alien to the plate, and long names clip mid-word with text-overflow:clip and no ellipsis.
defects.evidence: GenerateControls.vue:148 `class="flex-1 basis-[10rem] min-w-0 bg-transparent font-display font-medium text-subheading cursor-text rounded-sm hover:underline decoration-dashed underline-offset-4 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/40"`. Measured rest: {"border":"0px solid","textDecoration":"none","bg":"rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"} — indistinguishable from a heading. Measured truncation at 390 with a 51-char name: {"inputClientW":253,"inputScrollW":487,"inputTextOverflow":"clip"}; scratchpad/gen-390-max.png shows "A very long generated pale" cut mid-word inside a hard rectangular focus box. No disabled/error/empty-name state exists anywhere in the component. Canon: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §4 PR-07 ("Hover-only/unlabeled controls and invisible drag state -> ADD-AFFORDANCE / REMOVE"); VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4.1 ("Focus remains visibly distinct from selection in both schemes, forced colors and reduced transparency").
defects.mechanism: F4 state never designed — only the 1440-light rest state was authored; hover was used as the affordance carrier on a control that must also work on touch, and the focused/overflowing states fell through to defaults.
defects.reproduction: node probe: webkit 390x844, #/generate, fill [data-generate-plate] input[aria-label='Palette name'] with a 51-char string, read clientWidth/scrollWidth/textOverflow and screenshot; separately read the input's computed border/background/textDecoration at rest at 1440.
defects.proposedCure: Under D-1 + D-2's cure the naming job moves to the Library inspector (VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §5), where a real named form control with a persistent rest boundary, a canon focus ring (>=3:1, outline-based so it survives WHCM), a defined empty/invalid state and an honest overflow treatment already belongs. Do not add a per-instance focus/ellipsis patch to a control that should not be on the specimen plate.

defects.defect: Save and copy produce no truth of any kind — no status, no live region, no focus move, no state change — and the awaited clipboard result is discarded, so a clipboard rejection is indistinguishable from success.
defects.evidence: After a successful save, the route's only live region is an unrelated dev banner: feedback after save: {"liveRegions":["dev misconfigured — run `npm run dev`"]}. GenerateControls.vue:106-108 `async function copyColors() { await writeClipboard(palette.value.join(", ")); }` and :111-113 `copyColor` — both discard the awaited result. GeneratePane.vue:14-20 `onSave` returns void with no status wire. Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §5 ("Persistent operation state stays with the entity/workspace. A transient flourish may celebrate success but never carries the only truth"); PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §4 PR-08 ("Pending/failure/export/recovery truth only transient -> ADD-AFFORDANCE").
defects.mechanism: F4 state never designed — Generate is the degenerate case of PR-08: not "truth only transient" but zero truth. Compounded by D-2, where the save also silently rewrites the user's input.
defects.reproduction: node probe: webkit 1440x900, #/generate, click [data-generate-plate] button[aria-label='Save palette'], then enumerate [aria-live],[role='status'],[role='alert'] text content. Only the dev banner is present.
defects.proposedCure: Give the chassis action region a durable operation-state slot (saved-as identity + a link/handoff to the created Library entity), and make writeClipboard's boolean result drive a real state rather than being discarded. Under D-1 the commit region is a first-class chassis region, which is where that state belongs — not a toast.

defects.defect: RTL is broken by physical layout utilities: `ml-auto` does not flip, so the verb cluster seats at the inline START under dir=rtl (directly beneath the title instead of opposite it), and `text-right` points the count digit away from the slider it labels.
defects.evidence: GenerateControls.vue:156 `class="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0"` (comment at :153-155 states the intent as "right-seated"); :288 `class="... whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums w-5 text-right"`. Measured with document.documentElement.dir='rtl' at 1440: {"plate":{"x":754,"right":1216},"clusterX":970.2,"clusterRight":1203,"clusterInsetFromPlateInlineStart":13,"countLabelAlign":"right","firstDotX":1163,"docHScroll":0} — the cluster's edge is 13px from the plate's PHYSICAL right, which under RTL is the inline start. Visually confirmed in scratchpad/gen-rtl.png.
defects.mechanism: F4 state never designed — physical Tailwind utilities (ml-auto, text-right) used where logical ones (ms-auto, text-end) are required. The wrapping dot field flips correctly (firstDotX 1163 = inline start) and there is no horizontal overflow, so the defect is confined to these two utilities.
defects.reproduction: node probe: webkit 1440x900, #/generate, set document.documentElement.setAttribute('dir','rtl'), wait, then measure the .ml-auto cluster rect against the plate rect and read the count label's computed textAlign.
defects.proposedCure: Replace physical with logical utilities throughout the component (ms-auto / text-end / ps- / pe-), and prefer the chassis's own region ordering under D-1 so the action region's inline placement is producer-owned and direction-correct by construction rather than by consumer utility choice.

defects.defect: The plate triple-expresses one boundary — a 1px stroke, a material change, and a cartoon caster shadow — nested one level inside a Card that already draws its own edge and resting shadow, on a composition whose binding boundary set is empty.
defects.evidence: GenerateControls.vue:132 `class="rounded-card border border-card-edge bg-well shadow-cartoon-sm min-w-0"`. Measured: {"border":"1px","borderColor":"oklab(0.216129 0.003491 0.005182 / 0.12)","bg":"oklab(0.913299 …)","radius":"16px","shadow":"oklab(0.28 0.01676 0.024882 / 0.32) -2px 2px 0px 0px, …"}, inside a Card whose measured class list is "glass-resting card rounded-card text-card-foreground scrollbar-hidden". Canon: OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md §5 Generate row — P122 boundaries `[]`, reserve `none`, retained non-P122 line `none` — closing with "Any additional line, automatic P122 divider, consumer-hidden producer line, terminal row rule, caster stroke or corner rule is a defect"; PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §4 PR-05 and §5 card law 4 ("Spacing plus material already expressing the same boundary makes the line duplicative").
defects.mechanism: F1 wrong primitive — because the pane is a Card column rather than a chassis, the specimen needed its own hand-rolled shell to read as an object, and that shell reproduced Card's chrome (radius + edge + surface + cartoon shadow) out of raw utilities.
defects.reproduction: node probe: webkit 1440x900, #/generate, getComputedStyle([data-generate-plate]) -> borderTopWidth/borderTopColor/backgroundColor/boxShadow/borderTopLeftRadius, and read the enclosing [data-slot='card'] className.
defects.proposedCure: Under D-1 the plate becomes the chassis STAGE region, which carries its own material role and needs no shell: delete the border, the cartoon shadow and the local radius, keeping only the well material. Boundaries stay `[]` per the binding inventory.

defects.defect: A non-null-asserted injection is declared and never used: `cssColorOpaque` couples the pane to a provider it does not need and would throw on a provider-less mount for no benefit.
defects.evidence: GeneratePane.vue:10 `const cssColorOpaque = inject(CSS_COLOR_KEY)!;`. `grep -c "cssColorOpaque" demo/workbenches/generate/GeneratePane.vue` -> 1 (the declaration is its only occurrence); it appears nowhere in the template or the rest of the script.
defects.mechanism: F2 contract dropped at the seam — a copied pane preamble (MixPane.vue:15 has the identical line, where it IS consumed) carried an injection the Generate pane never wired up.
defects.reproduction: grep -c "cssColorOpaque" demo/workbenches/generate/GeneratePane.vue -> 1; read GeneratePane.vue lines 1-41 and confirm no further reference.
defects.proposedCure: Delete line 10 and the now-unused CSS_COLOR_KEY import at line 7. More broadly, the pane preamble should not be copied between workbenches — each pane declares only the ports it consumes (edict 1, focused modules with real encapsulation).

defects.defect: The expose bridge masks a guaranteed API with optional calls and uses a pre-3.5 template-ref idiom; a rename of the exposed methods would silently disable all six action seats.
defects.evidence: GeneratePane.vue:12 `const controlsRef = ref<InstanceType<typeof GenerateControls> | null>(null);` and :22-26 `defineExpose({ regenerate: () => controlsRef.value?.regenerate?.(), save: () => controlsRef.value?.save?.(), copyColors: () => controlsRef.value?.copyColors?.() });`. The second `?.` on each line guards methods that GenerateControls.vue:115 `defineExpose({ regenerate, save, copyColors })` provides unconditionally. The same masking repeats downstream at usePaneRouter.ts:196-198 `paneRefs.generate.value?.regenerate?.()`. Owner edicts 2 (no masking fallbacks) and 7 (idiomatic Vue 3.5 — useTemplateRef).
defects.mechanism: F2 contract dropped at the seam — defensive optional-calls over a compile-time-known interface convert a future rename from a type error into a silent no-op across every seat.
defects.reproduction: Read GeneratePane.vue:12,22-26 against GenerateControls.vue:115 — the guarded methods are unconditionally exposed, so the optional call can never be exercised except after a rename.
defects.proposedCure: The bridge should not exist at all once D-4 picks a single action owner. If any imperative handle survives, use `useTemplateRef("controlsRef")` with a typed non-optional call so a rename fails the typecheck instead of silently disabling the verbs.

defects.defect: Motion is untokenized and asymmetric across one verb's two seats: the swatch press uses a bare `transition-transform` with no duration/easing token, on an aria-hidden non-focusable span, while the same Regenerate verb animates in the Dock (rotateOnClick) and not in the plate.
defects.evidence: GenerateControls.vue:205 `class="generate-swatch w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 shrink-0 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-transform focus-visible:outline-none"` — no duration or easing token, resolving to Tailwind's bare default. usePaneRouter.ts:196 gives the Dock Regenerate `rotateOnClick: true`; GenerateControls.vue:157-164's plate Regenerate has no motion. Tokens exist: --animation-slide-sm/md/lg in demo/styles plus glass-ui --duration-*/--ease-*. Owner edict 6 (animations are never deleted, only moved or tokenized).
defects.mechanism: F3 reached past the design system for motion as well as for markup; the asymmetry is a direct consequence of D-4's duplication (two seats for one verb, authored at different times with different motion vocabularies).
defects.reproduction: Read GenerateControls.vue:205 (bare transition-transform, no token) against usePaneRouter.ts:196 (rotateOnClick:true) and GenerateControls.vue:157-164 (no motion). The dot's press feedback is unreachable by keyboard per D-3's measured tab order.
defects.proposedCure: Tokenize the transform transition against the existing duration/easing tokens, and resolve the asymmetry by D-4's single-owner decision so one verb has one motion. Note the global prefers-reduced-motion guard already neutralises this correctly — the defect is vocabulary and symmetry, not compliance.

defects.defect: Every operable seat in and around the plate falls below the 44px target floor, with no invisible seat geometry separating glyph size from hit size.
defects.evidence: Measured live at 1440x900 (all interactive elements under 44px on either axis, plate + this route's Dock bar): INPUT "Palette name" 398x31; BUTTON "Regenerate" (plate) 145x40; BUTTON "Save palette" 36x36; BUTTON "Copy all colors" 36x36; BUTTON "Generation preset" 225x36; BUTTON "Color harmony" 225x36; SPAN "Color count" (slider thumb) 12x24; Dock "Regenerate"/"Save palette"/"Copy colors" 32x32 each. Canon: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5 card law 7 and §4 PR-12 ("Invisible/seat geometry preserves target floor while optics follow rung"). The megatranche REPORT.md counts 5 small tap targets for /#/generate in every matrix (REPORT.md:38,53,68,83) — the enumeration above shows the true count is higher because the report's heuristic misses the slider thumb and the borderless input.
defects.mechanism: F4 state never designed — the glyph box IS the hit box everywhere in this component; PR-12's remedy (invisible seat larger than the visible rung) is nowhere applied.
defects.reproduction: node probe: webkit 1440x900, #/generate, enumerate button,[role='button'],a[href],input,[role='slider'] and filter to width<44 || height<44. Output pasted above.
defects.proposedCure: Apply PR-12's separation at the producer: glass-ui Button/Slider seats carry an invisible hit area meeting the 44px floor while the painted rung stays at its golden size. Do not inflate the visible chrome — card law 7 explicitly separates glyph size, target size and layout reservation.

defects.defect: The pane root carries two inert utilities copied from a sibling: `mx-auto` is a no-op beside `w-full`, and `relative` establishes a containing block no descendant uses.
defects.evidence: GeneratePane.vue:30 `<div class="relative w-full mx-auto h-full min-w-0">`, identical to ExtractPane.vue:2. No `absolute`-positioned descendant exists anywhere in GeneratePane.vue or GenerateControls.vue except the slider track div at GenerateControls.vue:293, which is positioned against its own `relative` parent at :292 — not against the pane root.
defects.mechanism: F1 wrong primitive — the same cloned pane recipe that produced D-1 also carried its dead utilities.
defects.reproduction: Read GeneratePane.vue:30 and ExtractPane.vue:2 (identical class strings); grep the component tree for an absolutely-positioned descendant of the pane root — the only `absolute` is scoped to GenerateControls.vue:292's own relative parent.
defects.proposedCure: Both classes disappear with D-1's chassis transposition, which owns the pane's outer geometry. Do not fix in isolation — fixing the utilities while keeping the Card column preserves the mechanism that produced them.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-system boundary, proportion/seat law)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m], 1M context) — explicitly declared at spawn, not inherited
result.strongestDefect: D-1 — the preview does not contain the image: `h-full` against an indefinite parent makes `object-contain` a no-op, so a 4:3 photo is clipped 6.8%, a portrait photo loses 76.7%, and at large overflow ratios the preview renders ZERO image pixels (blank plate) in 2 of 3 measured matrices — while the result column still reads "undeveloped plate — feed it an image". Every capture of this component in the entire mega-tranche visual matrix is EMPTY, which is why no prior audit saw it.
result.negativeProof: N/A — verdict is DEFECTIVE. Clean negatives recorded in the report: reduced motion IS honoured (computed transition-duration 0.1s, transform dropped, via the global guard at demo/styles/animations.css:184-193, not the component); the ImagePlus glyph passes non-text contrast (4.32:1 light / 4.24:1 dark); Enter and Space DO open the picker in the empty state (fileInputClicks: 2); zero horizontal overflow / page errors / console errors attributable to the component on /#/extract in all 4 matrices; verbatimModuleSyntax satisfied (both imports are value imports); useTemplateRef used idiomatically at :78; not a god module (114 lines); rounded-xl on the img is a token-family slip only — --radius-panel and --radius-xl both compute to 12px with corner-shape: round, so no visible mismatch; and the 6 smallTapTargets + 3 namelessButtons on /#/extract belong to PaletteSlugBar and the ExtractControls slider thumbs, NOT to this component (its target is 462x180).

defects.defect: The image preview does not contain the image. `h-full` (height:100%) against a parent with indefinite height (height:auto + max-height) resolves to `auto`, so the takes its intrinsic height and `object-fit:contain` becomes a dead declaration; `overflow-hidden` then silently center-crops. At large overflow ratios the preview paints nothing at all — a blank plate.
defects.evidence: demo/workbenches/extract/ImageDropZone.vue:41 (`w-full h-full object-contain`) inside :8-9 (`flex flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-hidden`), caller max-h at demo/workbenches/extract/ExtractWorkbench.vue:20.
